"""Reviewer probe (ACT-W2-149-INSTALL-1, third build): the launch script's own parser over APPROVED.before/.after,
and every line's hash against the bytes at given commits, by the script's own blob() and constants.
usage: python3 -I -B probe_list.py <repo> <drafts dir> <commit> [<commit> ...]"""
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import os
import sys

repo, drafts, commits = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3:]
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(
    "indep_launch_probe", os.path.join(repo, "governance/project/orchestration/tools/indep_launch.py"))
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(m)


def sha(b):
    return hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()


before = open(os.path.join(drafts, "APPROVED.before"), "rb").read()
after = open(os.path.join(drafts, "APPROVED.after"), "rb").read()
print("before sha", sha(before), "lines", before.count(b"\n"))
print("after  sha", sha(after), "lines", after.count(b"\n"), "ends with newline", after.endswith(b"\n"))
tb, bb = m.parse_approved(before)
ta, ba = m.parse_approved(after)
print("before: template lines", len(tb), "brief lines", len(bb))
print("after:  template lines", len(ta), "brief lines", len(ba), "kinds", sorted(set(k for _h, k, _p in ba)))
print("after: template files the script needs, all present:",
      sorted(ta) == sorted(f"{m.TEMPLATE_DIR}/{n}" for n in m.TEMPLATE_FILES))
print("after: one hash per template file:", all(len(v) == 1 for v in ta.values()))
# the after head equals the before list with exactly the two template lines changed
bl = before.split(b"\n")
al = after.split(b"\n")
diff = [i + 1 for i in range(len(bl) - 1) if bl[i] != al[i]]
print("head lines differing from before (1-based):", diff)
for i in diff:
    print("  before:", bl[i - 1].decode()[:12], bl[i - 1].decode()[64:])
    print("  after: ", al[i - 1].decode()[:12], al[i - 1].decode()[64:])
# every non-matching, non-comment, non-blank line in after (would be silently skipped by the parser)
import re
odd = [ln for ln in after.decode().splitlines() if ln.strip() and not ln.lstrip().startswith("#")
       and not re.fullmatch(r"([0-9a-f]{64})\s+(template|brief)\s+(.+?)\s*", ln)]
print("after: lines the parser skips that are not comments:", odd)
print("after: comment lines", sum(1 for ln in after.decode().splitlines() if ln.lstrip().startswith("#")))
print("after: duplicate brief hashes:", len(ba) != len(set(h for h, _k, _p in ba)))
for c in commits:
    print("== commit", c)
    for rel, hs in sorted(ta.items()):
        data = m.blob(repo, c, rel)
        h = sha(data) if data is not None else None
        print("  template", rel.rsplit("/", 1)[1], "matches after:", hs == {h}, "matches before:", tb.get(rel) == {h},
              (h or "absent")[:12])
    for h, k, p in ba:
        data = m.blob(repo, c, p)
        draft = os.path.join(drafts, "briefs", os.path.basename(p))
        dmatch = sha(open(draft, "rb").read()) == h if os.path.isfile(draft) and "sgx1" in p else None
        print("  brief", k, p, "at commit:", "absent" if data is None else ("match" if sha(data) == h else "MISMATCH"),
              "draft match:", dmatch)
        if data is not None and k in m.KINDS:
            fm = m.front_matter(data)
            print("    front matter kind", fm.get("kind") if fm else None, "brief id", fm.get("brief") if fm else None)
    s = m.blob(repo, c, "governance/project/orchestration/tools/indep_launch.py")
    print("  launch script", sha(s)[:12] if s else None)
